channel.title: Massachusetts and RI Lawyers Weekly - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Massachusetts and RI Lawyers Weekly (masslawyersweekly.com)

item.title: IG: Both sides at fault for ‘chaotic’ sheriffs’ budget process
item.description: Massachusetts Inspector General Jeff Shapiro reports the county sheriffs' budget process is flawed, with overspending and underfunding causing deficits.

item.title: Lawsuit says Google’s Gemini AI chatbot drove man to suicide
item.description: Google faces a lawsuit after a Florida man’s family alleges its Gemini AI chatbot caused his paranoia and suicide. The complaint claims emotional manipulation by the AI.

item.title: Healey nominates judges for Probate, Juvenile courts
item.description: With the nominations on March 4 of new judges for the Probate & Family and Juvenile courts, Gov. Maura T. Healey said she has now put forward more than 100 jurists.

item.title: SJC adopts revised model jury instructions on eyewitness IDs
item.description: The Massachusetts Supreme Judicial Court has approved revised 2026 model jury instructions on eyewitness identification reflecting recent scientific developments and clearer language.

item.title: The choice we’re making about AI
item.description: About half of CEOs report significant time savings from AI. Workers using the same tools? Two-thirds reported minimal or no time savings.

item.title: Judgment After Rescript (Reinstatement Denied) entered by Justice Gaziano on Feb. 25
item.description: SJC No. 2015-042 In re: Valeriano Diviacchi 24 Holton St. Boston, MA 02134 Judgment After Rescript (Reinstatement Denied) entered by Justice Gaziano on Feb. 25, 2026

item.title: Admonition No. 26-03
item.description: In July 2024, a Texas resident (the “client”) rented a residential property in Houston, Texas. In August 2024, the client vacated the property and stopped paying rent after learning that he could not use the property as a group home.

item.title: Admonition No. 26-04
item.description: This matter came to Bar Counsel’s attention as the result of a dishonored check notice from the respondent’s IOLTA account. The respondent is a partner in a large-volume real estate closing firm that utilizes multiple IOLTA accounts.

item.title: SJC seeks amicus briefs for posted cases
item.description: The Supreme Judicial Court seeks amicus briefs on cases involving tenant protections, sports wagering, self-representation rights, and constitutional issues.

item.title: Media co. declines to produce podcasts, prompting suit
item.description: The plaintiff sued the defendant media company for declining to contract to produce podcasts for it.
